name: ba-predict
description: Baccarat bet advisor: exact shoe-aware odds, per-bet EV, and honest bet sizing. PWA + mobile.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ba-predict/engine && npm run build --workspace @ba-predict/app-core && npm run build --workspace @ba-predict/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @ba-predict/engine && npm run test --workspace @ba-predict/app-core
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ba-predict/engine && npm run typecheck --workspace @ba-predict/app-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @ba-predict/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @ba-predict/mobile
